messages:
anita: Heads-up — I want to pin provider + module versions for the tenant-network apply during tomorrow's release window (canary first). Requesting deploybot hold on automatic mergers and an explicit rollout window: 03/21 02:00–04:00 UTC.

kyle: Ack. Which modules exactly?

anita: module.vpc@v2.4.1 and module.router@2026-03-18 (we're avoiding the new route propagation change). Also pin provider aws to 5.12.0.

marie: Adding release notes item: "Tenant-network: provider/module pins to stabilize peering during cutover" — will include rollback steps.

chris: For rollback criteria, propose: > 1. 5% error rate on control-plane API for >10m OR >2min median increase in cold-start latency for infra services. If hit, immediate revert to previous module versions and drain new nodes.

anita: Agreed. Also add a traffic-shift safeguard: keep old routing variant available and set deploybot circuit to 50% canary for 30m then 100% if green.

kyle: How do we tell deploybot to hold merging and set the canary policy?

anita: Use the deploybot CLI:```deploybot hold --reason "pinning for tenant-network cutover" --team eng-infra``` then set policy:```deploybot rollout --target=tenant-network --policy "canary:50%:30m -> 100%"```

deploybot: @channel Hold placed by anita for tenant-network. Auto-merge disabled. Current holds: 1 (eng-infra pin).

marie: QA will run the smoke prompt: run `terraform plan -var-file=prod.pin.tfvars` against staging canary. I put the exact var file in the release playbook.

chris: Copy of the minimal plan I expect:
```diff
~ module.router.aws_route.propagation: change from true -> false (propagation toggle)
+ module.router.version: 2026-03-18 pinned
```

anita: If the canary plan matches expectations, we'll kick the canary apply at 02:10 and monitor. If we see routing regression, use the emergency revert steps in the playbook.

sre-bot: ALERT: During the last test canary we saw a 7% increase in API error 500s for auth-service for ~8 minutes. Flagged to eng-sre.

kyle: That's concerning. Was that caused by the previous module change?

marie: QA says it was correlated with the last router module test — seems to coincide with a route flap during kube-probes.

anita: Okay, new plan: we extend the canary to 60m and reduce canary traffic to 20% for the first 20m. I'll also pin the probe timeout on the instance group so probes have margin.

chris: Recommended escape hatch commands (from playbook):
```bash
# revert to previous module versions
git checkout tags/tenant-network-pre-pin
deploybot rollback --target=tenant-network --version pre-pin
# drain new nodes
kubectl cordon -l app=tenant-network -n infra && kubectl drain -l app=tenant-network -n infra --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```

anita: Leaving this thread as the canonical rollout plan. If anyone objects to the longer canary, speak now. Otherwise I'll update release notes and schedule the deploybot rollout. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kyle: No objections. Please post the final playbook link when updated.

marie: Will attach notes + postmortem template.

deploybot: Rollout scheduled by anita for 2026-03-21T02:10:00Z. Canary policy: 20% for 20m, 20% for additional 40m (extended monitoring), then 100% if no regressions. Auto-merge still disabled.

anita: Thanks — I'll run a final smoke at 01:50 UTC and ping this thread with `terraform apply` output.

(01:50 UTC) anita: Running `terraform apply -var-file=prod.pin.tfvars -target=module.router` now, will paste plan summary in 2m.

(01:52 UTC) anita: Plan summary: 1 to change, 0 to add, 0 to destroy. No unexpected diffs. Hash: abc123. Proceeding with canary apply.

(02:30 UTC) sre-bot: METRIC: auth-service 5xx rate spiked to 6.8% (alert threshold 5%) for 12m during canary -> Escalation recommended.

(02:31 UTC) anita: Initiating rollback per criteria. Executing rollback steps now.

(02:32 UTC) deploybot: Rollback started by anita for tenant-network -> target version pre-pin. ETA ~5m.

(02:36 UTC) deploybot: Rollback complete. All tenant-network modules restored to pre-pin versions. Canary traffic reverted.

(02:38 UTC) chris: Post-rollback checks: kube-probes stable, route tables show previous entries, auth-service 5xx back to 0.7% within 4m.

(02:40 UTC) anita: Thanks team. We'll abort the 03/21 main cutover and schedule a deep-dive with infra+qa+platform tomorrow. I'll file a postmortem and include timeline + remediation. :memo:

marie: I'll draft the incident notes and include the playbook gaps.

kyle: Good catch on the canary config — glad the rollback path worked cleanly.

anita: Closing thread: hold will remain until we fix probe timeout coupling. deploybot, remove hold when anita gives the go-ahead.

deploybot: Hold remains. Use `deploybot hold --release` to remove.
